title: A Poet Has No Land
author: Pradip Biswal, Editor
text:
A Poet has no land
No borders
No barriers
Of nationality
Caste creed
And colour.
He knows
Blood is red
No matter
What you are.
Love is life
Life`s love
For him
Always.
Love blooms
Like flowers
All the seasons
Say it spring
Autumn
Or winter
Life`s beautiful
Each moment.
He wages war
Against all those
Involved in
Bloodshed
Genocide
Crime against man.
He`s the ambassador
Of peace
And humanity
Love and compassion
Beyond the borders
Dividing the globe.
